articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

images.name: Tete Yengi [1296x729]
images.caption: Tete Yengi
images.alt: Tete Yengi

images.name: What are the expectations for Australia at the World Cup?
images.caption: Joey Lynch reacts to Australia's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

images.name: Tete Yengi [1296x729]
images.caption: Tete Yengi
images.alt: Tete Yengi

images.name: What are the expectations for Australia at the World Cup?
images.caption: Joey Lynch reacts to Australia's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

link.text: All AFC Champions League Elite News

articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

images.name: Tete Yengi [1296x729]
images.caption: Tete Yengi
images.alt: Tete Yengi

images.name: What are the expectations for Australia at the World Cup?
images.caption: Joey Lynch reacts to Australia's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.description: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

link.text: All AFC Champions League Elite News

articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

images.name: Tete Yengi [1296x729]
images.caption: Tete Yengi
images.alt: Tete Yengi

images.name: What are the expectations for Australia at the World Cup?
images.caption: Joey Lynch reacts to Australia's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Ronaldo scores in Al Nassr win after security delay in Riyadh
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored what proved to be the decisive goal in Al Nassr's Asian Champions League Elite win over Neftchi Fergana on Monday in Saudi Arabia.

images.name: Ronaldo celeb Al Nassr_261012 [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo celebrates after scoring a goal for Al Nassr in the Asian Champions League.

articles.headline: Treble-collecting Mark Jackson ready to take Lion City Sailors to the next level
articles.description: Lion City Sailors' Mark Jackson era will begin on Thursday against BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: Mark Jackson of Lion City Sailors [1296x729]
images.caption: After his appointment was announced last week, Mark Jackson will take charge of Lion City Sailors for the first time on Thursday when they entertain BG Pathum United in the AFC Champions League Two.

images.name: New Sailors coach Jackson relishes challenge of reaching Asian summit
images.caption: New Lion City Sailors coach Mark Jackson is ready to help the club establish themselves as one of Asia's best clubs, as he did with previous side Buriram United.

articles.headline: Ronaldo suffers biggest loss with Al Nassr in Asian CL rout
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo suffered his heaviest loss since joining Al Nassr as the Saudi Arabian champion kicked off its Asian Champions League Elite campaign with a 4-0 defeat to Al Ain

images.name: Ronaldo woe [1296x729]
images.caption: Cristiano Ronaldo and Al Nassr began the AFC Champions League Elite with a heavy loss to Al Ain.
images.alt: Cristiano Ronaldo (R) of Al-Nassr in action during the AFC Champions League match between Al Ain and Al-Nassr at Hazza Bin Zayed Stadium in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates, on September 15, 2026.
images.credit: Hassan al Raisi/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Treble-winning Sandy Walsh could not have asked for better first season at Buriram United
articles.description: Sandy Walsh enjoyed a success-filled first season with Buriram United -- but what does the future hold for him?

images.name: Sandy Walsh [1296x729]
images.caption: Sandy Walsh's first season at Buriram United saw him win three titles in the form of the Thai League 1, Thai FA Cup and ASEAN Club Championship.

images.name: Buriram's road to the ASEAN Club Championship crown
images.caption: Relive Buriram United's entire journey as they claimed a second consecutive ASEAN Club Championship title.

articles.headline: Tete Yengi credits journeyman career for World Cup call-up
articles.description: Socceroos bolter Tete Yengi says his journey to the national team has not been straightforward, but he believes these adventures have played a key role in his pursuit of becoming the "ultimate player" and, more importantly, a World Cup representative.

images.name: Tete Yengi [1296x729]
images.caption: Tete Yengi
images.alt: Tete Yengi

images.name: What are the expectations for Australia at the World Cup?
images.caption: Joey Lynch reacts to Australia's squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Atalanta 1, Venezia 0. Franck Kessie (Atalanta) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Nikola Krstovic with a through ball.
Goal! Atalanta 2, Venezia 0. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Eljif Elmas with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Venezia. Richie Sagrado replaces Thierry Correia because of an injury.
Matías Moreno (Venezia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Atalanta 3, Venezia 0. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Atalanta 3, Venezia 1. Antoine Hainaut (Venezia) header from the right side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Richie Sagrado with a cross.
Juan Jesus (Venezia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Atalanta 3, Venezia 1.
Substitution, Atalanta. Lazar Samardzic replaces Charles De Ketelaere.
Delay in match because of an injury Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Atalanta. Sead Kolasinac replaces Giorgio Scalvini because of an injury.
Substitution, Atalanta. Lorenzo Bernasconi replaces Raoul Bellanova because of an injury.
Substitution, Atalanta. Nicola Zalewski replaces Jonathan Rowe.
Substitution, Atalanta. Gianluca Gaetano replaces Franck Kessie.
Substitution, Venezia. Thórir Helgason replaces Toma Basic.
Substitution, Venezia. Joël Schingtienne replaces Matías Moreno.
Substitution, Venezia. Lion Lauberbach replaces Akor Adams.
Substitution, Venezia. Albion Rrahmani replaces Simon Sohm.

articles.headline: From Leicester to Leverkusen, Mjällby join unlikely league champions
articles.description: Mjällby, the team from a fishing village with a population of 800, are league champions! When it comes to shock title wins, they are in good company.

images.name: Mjallby celebrate winning Swedish title [1296x729]
images.credit: JOHAN NILSSON/TT NEWS AGENCY/AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Could another team repeat Leicester's shock Premier League title win?
images.caption: Tom Hamilton joins "The Football Reporters" podcast to explain why the odds are stacked against any club hoping to repeat Leicester City's unlikely Premier League title win.

articles.headline: Mjällby wins Swedish league title to cap astounding season
articles.description: Mjällby, a tiny team from a remote fishing village next to the Baltic Sea, won the Swedish league title on Monday for one of the most remarkable achievements in European soccer.

images.name: Mjällby Swedish title [1024x576]
images.caption: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.
images.alt: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.

articles.headline: Ballon d'Or: Erling Haaland skips awards to watch Malmö game
articles.description: Erling Haaland won't attend Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony in Paris, preferring instead a trip to Sweden where his friend can win the league with Malmö.

images.name: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium [1296x729]
images.alt: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium

images.name: Premier League in numbers: 74 in 75 for Erling Haaland
images.caption: Take a look at the best stats from Saturday's Premier League action, as Erling Haaland's excellent scoring record continues.

articles.headline: Stockholm derby suspended after fans throw pyrotechnics
articles.description: The Stockholm derby between Djurgarden and Hammarby was suspended in the second half Sunday after supporters threw three smoke bombs onto the field.

images.name: Djurgarden v Hammarby - Pyrotechnics [1296x729]
images.caption: Djurgarden supporters' pyrotechnics disrupted the game, leading to a lengthy delay and eventual suspension.
images.credit: Magnus Lejhall/TT News Agency via AP

articles.headline: Swedish FA not considering VAR after clubs raise objections
articles.description: Sweden's top leagues will not look to implement a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system after clubs voiced their opposition to the technology, Swedish Football Association (SvFF) Chairman Fredrik Reinfeldt said.

articles.headline: Orange County SC striker Ronaldo Damus closing in on move to Sweden's GIF Sundsvall - sources
articles.description: Orange County Soccer Club is close to finalizing the transfer of striker Ronaldo Damus to Sundsvall in the Swedish Allsvenskan, sources told ESPN.

images.name: Ronaldo Damus 210711 [1296x729]
images.caption: Ronaldo Damus

articles.headline: From Leicester to Leverkusen, Mjällby join unlikely league champions
articles.description: Mjällby, the team from a fishing village with a population of 800, are league champions! When it comes to shock title wins, they are in good company.

images.name: Mjallby celebrate winning Swedish title [1296x729]
images.credit: JOHAN NILSSON/TT NEWS AGENCY/AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Could another team repeat Leicester's shock Premier League title win?
images.caption: Tom Hamilton joins "The Football Reporters" podcast to explain why the odds are stacked against any club hoping to repeat Leicester City's unlikely Premier League title win.

articles.headline: Mjällby wins Swedish league title to cap astounding season
articles.description: Mjällby, a tiny team from a remote fishing village next to the Baltic Sea, won the Swedish league title on Monday for one of the most remarkable achievements in European soccer.

images.name: Mjällby Swedish title [1024x576]
images.caption: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.
images.alt: Mjällby, a small team from a fishing village on the Baltic Sea, are champions of Sweden's Allsvenskan.

articles.headline: Ballon d'Or: Erling Haaland skips awards to watch Malmö game
articles.description: Erling Haaland won't attend Monday's Ballon d'Or ceremony in Paris, preferring instead a trip to Sweden where his friend can win the league with Malmö.

images.name: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium [1296x729]
images.alt: Erling Haaland of Manchester City during the Premier League match between Manchester City FC and Southampton FC at Etihad Stadium

images.name: Premier League in numbers: 74 in 75 for Erling Haaland
images.caption: Take a look at the best stats from Saturday's Premier League action, as Erling Haaland's excellent scoring record continues.

articles.headline: Stockholm derby suspended after fans throw pyrotechnics
articles.description: The Stockholm derby between Djurgarden and Hammarby was suspended in the second half Sunday after supporters threw three smoke bombs onto the field.

images.name: Djurgarden v Hammarby - Pyrotechnics [1296x729]
images.caption: Djurgarden supporters' pyrotechnics disrupted the game, leading to a lengthy delay and eventual suspension.
images.credit: Magnus Lejhall/TT News Agency via AP

articles.headline: Swedish FA not considering VAR after clubs raise objections
articles.description: Sweden's top leagues will not look to implement a Video Assistant Referee (VAR) system after clubs voiced their opposition to the technology, Swedish Football Association (SvFF) Chairman Fredrik Reinfeldt said.

articles.headline: Orange County SC striker Ronaldo Damus closing in on move to Sweden's GIF Sundsvall - sources
articles.description: Orange County Soccer Club is close to finalizing the transfer of striker Ronaldo Damus to Sundsvall in the Swedish Allsvenskan, sources told ESPN.

images.name: Ronaldo Damus 210711 [1296x729]
images.caption: Ronaldo Damus
images.alt: Ronaldo Damus

articles.headline: Norwegian club win CAS case over 'UEFA mafia' banners and chants
articles.description: Norwegian club SK Brann claimed victory for free speech on Sunday with the CAS ruling that they did not have to pay a fine imposed by UEFA.

articles.description: Goalkeeper Jan de Boer was named man of the match in Bryne's Norwegian league season opener against Bodo/Glimt. His reward? Four trays of eggs.

images.name: Amazing kickoff goal from halfway in Irish women's league
images.caption: Shamrock Rovers' Ruesha Littlejohn catches the opposition goalkeeper off guard to score directly from kick-off in the League of Ireland.

articles.headline: Norway votes to keep VAR despite opposition from clubs
articles.description: Norwegian soccer decided to keep using video reviews to assist referees in its top league after a vote at a congress of its national soccer federation on Saturday.

images.name: Why the Norwegian FA ignored clubs' calls to scrap VAR
images.caption: Gab Marcotti and Julien Laurens discuss the outcome of the Norwegian FA's vote on whether to keep using VAR.

articles.headline: Norway top-flight clubs vote to scrap VAR amid fan outrage
articles.description: Norway is set to become the first country to abandon VAR after 19 of its 32 clubs voted Wednesday to scrap video refereeing in the country's top division.

articles.headline: Fans vs. VAR: Norway's fight for football's future
articles.description: Protests involving fishcakes and tennis balls turned Norway's anti-VAR movement into a global news story, and the attention has led to a vote. Could they vote VAR out of the league?

articles.headline: Lyon owner John Textor to reduce role after relegation

articles.headline: French giants Lyon relegated to Ligue 2 over financial issues
articles.description: Seven-time French champions Lyon, owned by American businessman John Textor, have been relegated to the second tier of French football due to the club's financial problems.

article.headline: Coventry put four past Newcastle to climb out of relegation zone
article.description: Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.
article.linkText: Coventry stun Newcastle with emphatic 4-1 win
article.story:
Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.

The last time Newcastle played on a Monday night they were hammered 4-1 by Leeds and suffered the same miserable fate in Coventry less than a month later.

Jack Rudoni's sixth-minute penalty gave Frank Lampard's side a dream start and their first Premier League goal in front of their own fans since John Hartson scored in a 1-0 win over Sunderland in April 2001.

It was the first time Coventry fans had seen a Premier League goal at the Coventry Building Society Arena with their last goal in the top flight coming at Highfield Road.

Bobby Thomas' last-man clearance left Matias Fernandez-Pardo waiting for his first goal for the club and that proved to be vital as Sidiki Cherif doubled the hosts lead three minutes into the second period.

Newcastle got themselves back in the contest through a belter from Sven Botman after 70 minutes but Coventry were not to be denied as Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni ensured they moved out of the drop zone with successive wins to draw level on points with Manchester United on a memorable night.

Newcastle started sloppily which set the tone for their disappointing evening, and it led to goalkeeper Lukás Hornícek giving away a penalty in the fourth minute.

The Czech goalkeeper spilled Brandon Thomas-Asante's routine ball and then brought down Cherif before Rudoni calmly sent him the wrong way from 12 yards.

The visitors settled and looked to respond, winger Harvey Barnes looked lively and collected a pass from Joe Willock before firing straight at Carl Rushworth for their first shot on target.

The Sky Blues had a glorious chance to make it two with their first touch inside Newcastle's box since the goal.

Jacob Murphy's cross was cleared by Milan van Ewijk which set Cherif on the counter attack and beyond a high Magpies line but he could only aim straight at Hornicek.

Newcastle should have been on level terms a couple of minutes before the break when Fernandez-Pardo got in behind the Coventry defence from a long clearance, he rounded Rushworth only to see his goalbound effort blocked on the line by the covering Thomas.

Coventry caught Newcastle cold at the start of the second period too as they doubled their advantage.

A long throw into the box was headed out by Malick Thiaw but only into the path of Cherif who arrowed low and hard through several Newcastle bodies and into the bottom right corner.

The Magpies needed something special to get themselves back in the contest and it came when Botman lined one up on the left edge of the area with a bullet too fast for Rushworth to halve the deficit.

The momentum seemingly swung by the way of the visitors but Coventry somehow managed to restore their two-goal lead.

Thomas-Asante dispossessed Joelinton outside his own box and the ball dropped to Simms who saw his effort deflect off Thiaw and in to make it three after 81 minutes.

Newcastle's night was over, and Thomas-Asante struck the post but it did not stop them from suffering further when substitute Mfuni cracked in a fourth five minutes later, just moments after stepping off the bench.

articles.headline: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf as head coach after seven consecutive league defeats
articles.description: Corinthians hired Clarence Seedorf on Sunday for the Netherlands playing great's first coaching job since 2019 -- and a relegation fight in Brazil's top tier.

articles.headline: Corinthians hire Clarence Seedorf as head coach after seven consecutive league defeats

articles.headline: Philippe Coutinho reveals Neymar's 'important role' in Santos transfer
